name: log_visit
description: Log what happened in a visit from the rep's own words. Pass the words verbatim, never paraphrase.
say: Read spoken_summary, then ask each missing_fields question, then offer pending approvals. For a correction of a debrief already logged, pass only the correction words as utterance and that debrief's voice_log_id as corrects_voice_log_id; code undoes and re-logs it.
